postcss-plugin-moved.title: Runbook: install @tailwindcss/postcss and point postcss.config.js at it instead of tailwindcss directly, a package swap plus a config edit, not a callable fix

v3-directives-silent-noop.title: Runbook: replace the three @tailwind directives with @import "tailwindcss"; a source edit, not a callable fix

js-config-not-autoloaded.title: Runbook: add @config "./tailwind.config.js"; to the CSS entry point to keep the JS config, or migrate its theme values into a CSS-native @theme block instead, which one is right depends on how much of the config is left to migrate
